Lower Text: [All Turns] While you have a red Digimon in play, this Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞. (When this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple or red card with [Free] in its traits or 1 card with [Imperialdramon] in its name among them to your hand, and trash 1 card among them. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
